subtopics.title: India-France Partnership
subtopics.summary: India and France upgraded their ties to a Special Global Strategic Partnership during the French President's visit. Cooperation spans defence manufacturing, technology, critical minerals, nuclear energy and trade. The 2026 India-France Year of Innovation and the Horizon 2047 roadmap set the course for future ties.
facts: Ties upgraded to Special Global Strategic Partnership during French President's visit
H125 helicopter final assembly line inaugurated at Vemagal, Karnataka (TATA-Airbus)
Joint venture of Bharat Electronics and Safran to produce HAMMER missile in India
2026 is the India-France Year of Innovation; India-France Innovation Network established
Joint declaration to secure diversified, resilient supply chains of critical minerals
Bilateral trade FY 2024-25: EUR 12.67 billion; France is 11th largest foreign investor in India
France is India's most frequent Republic Day Chief Guest (6th time)
India and France jointly constructing Jaitapur nuclear park in Maharashtra with EDF
Namaste France 2028 to celebrate 30 years of Strategic Partnership

subtopics.title: Chabahar Port and Arab League
subtopics.summary: Iran reaffirmed its commitment to Chabahar Port despite US sanctions uncertainty, and India Ports Global operates the port's terminals. The port gives India a route to Afghanistan and Central Asia that bypasses Pakistan. India and the Arab League also adopted the Delhi Declaration.
facts: Chabahar is Iran's only ocean-facing deep-water port, on the Makran Coast near the Strait of Hormuz
Chabahar is about 550 nautical miles from Gujarat's Kandla Port
Discussions on Indian participation began in 2002; formal recognition came in the 2003 New Delhi Declaration
India Ports Global assumed operational control of Chabahar Port in 2018
In 2024, India signed a 10-year contract to operate Shahid Beheshti and Shahid Kalantari terminals
Chabahar is an integral part of the International North-South Transport Corridor
Arab League was established in 1945 in Cairo; it has 22 members including Palestine
Arab States supply over 47% of India's crude oil imports
Over 9 million Indians reside and work in Arab League countries

subtopics.title: Malaysia and Seychelles Visits
subtopics.summary: The Prime Minister's visit to Malaysia produced a joint statement covering defence, digital and trade cooperation. Seychelles' President visited India to announce the SESEL joint vision, marking 50 years of diplomatic relations, along with a USD 175 million assistance package. Both visits stress disaster-resilient infrastructure, and the Seychelles visit also stresses maritime security.
facts: India and Malaysia set up a Strategic Affairs Working Group and a Su-30 Forum for air forces
Malaysia-India Digital Council formalised for fintech, AI, cybersecurity and e-governance
RBI and Bank Negara Malaysia to promote local currency settlement
Malaysia is India's 3rd largest trading partner in ASEAN
Harimau Shakti (5th Edition) is a joint military exercise with Malaysia
Malaysia formally acceded to the International Big Cat Alliance
SESEL: Joint Vision for Sustainability, Growth and Security through Enhanced Linkages
India announced a USD 175 million assistance package for Seychelles
Seychelles to become a full member of the Colombo Security Conclave

subtopics.title: Law, Governance and Parliament
subtopics.summary: The Supreme Court questioned WhatsApp's 2021 privacy policy in an appeal against a CCI penalty, flagging data sharing and consent concerns. The topic also covers the Motion of Thanks, the removal procedure for the Lok Sabha Speaker, the Governor's address and the Sahyog Portal. Other items include MTP Act limits, the Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority and Bharat Taxi.
facts: WhatsApp's 2021 privacy policy allows user data sharing with Facebook (Meta) and group companies
Supreme Court flagged commercial exploitation of data, abuse of dominant position and lack of informed consent
Motion of Thanks is moved after the President's address; PM replies by convention
Speaker removal needs a resolution passed by a majority of all then members, with 14 days' notice
Speaker cannot preside during own removal discussion and cannot use a casting vote
Delhi High Court: Section 79 safe harbour does not exempt intermediaries from Sahyog Portal compliance
Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority gets devolved powers over 46 subjects; Article 371(A) unaffected
MTP Act: up to 20 weeks needs 1 registered medical practitioner; 20-24 weeks needs 2
Bharat Taxi is a driver-owned cooperative; 80% of earnings go directly to Sarathis

subtopics.title: Economy, Science, Defence and Space
subtopics.summary: The 10-year government bond yield rose to 6.77%, the highest closing level since mid-January 2025. Science and innovation efforts include the BIRAC-run RDI Fund and the BioE3 policy, while defence approvals and India's command of CTF-154 mark a wider maritime role. Two telescope projects in Ladakh will add to India's observatory network.
facts: 10-year government bond yield raised to 6.77%; bond yields and prices move in opposite directions
One State One RRB policy (from 2005) merges multiple regional rural banks within a state
Digital rupee: e-W for wholesale interbank use, e-R for retail; CBDC food coupon pilot under PDS
BIRAC RDI Fund is a 6-year scheme supporting technologies at TRL 4 and above
Defence Acquisition Council approved proposals including Rafale (4.5 generation) and P-81 aircraft
India assumed command of Combined Task Force 154, the maritime training task force, for the first time
Combined Maritime Forces has 47 nations including India; headquarters at Manama (Bahrain)
National Large Solar Telescope: 2-metre aperture, located at Merak (Ladakh)
National Large Optical Telescope: 13.7-metre segmented mirror telescope at Hanle (Ladakh)
US launched the FORGE initiative on critical minerals at the Critical Minerals Ministerial

quizzes.passage: India and France have upgraded their ties to a special global strategic partnership during a visit by the French President. Cooperation between the two countries now spans defence manufacturing, technology, critical minerals, nuclear energy and trade. The economic side includes cooperation on the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor, and the partnership also includes joint military exercises by the army, navy and air force. A final assembly line for a light utility helicopter has been inaugurated in India as part of a private aviation facility. A joint venture with a French firm will also produce a missile in India. Earth observation is another area of joint work, and the two countries have agreed to amend their double tax avoidance agreement. A large nuclear project is being built in India with a French utility. The roadmap sets the course for the bilateral relationship in all areas. France has been the Chief Guest at India's Republic Day celebrations more than once. Namaste France 2028 is planned as a celebration of the partnership, marking a milestone in its long history. The two sides have also agreed on a joint declaration about critical minerals. Each of these areas is covered in the joint outcomes announced during the visit.

quizzes.passage: Chabahar Port is located on the Makran Coast of Iran, close to the Gulf of Oman and the Strait of Hormuz. It is the Iranian port closest to India, and it offers a direct route to Afghanistan and Central Asia that avoids Pakistan. India has been involved with the port for a long time, and the port has been developed through agreements between the two countries. The Chabahar-Zahedan railway is planned to connect the port to Afghanistan's highway network. The Arab League is a regional organisation of Arab countries that coordinates policies on political, security, economic and legal issues. Its region is the Middle East and parts of Africa. The organisation stresses respect for the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all states and calls for cooperation against terrorism. The Arab League has also supported reforms of the United Nations Security Council to reflect contemporary global realities. India and the Arab League have adopted a joint declaration on peace, security and global governance. The Arab States supply a large share of India's crude oil imports, and many Indians live and work in Arab League countries. Stability in the region is considered vital for India's energy security and supply chains. Chabahar also offers India a counterbalance in the Arabian Sea.

quizzes.passage: India's Prime Minister made an official visit to Malaysia, and the two countries issued a joint statement covering strategic, defence, digital and trade cooperation. The defence part of the statement focuses on maintenance, technical expertise and supply chain resilience. Both sides emphasised balanced and diversified bilateral trade, with priority given to semiconductors, the digital economy and advanced manufacturing. Malaysia has also reiterated its commitment to the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea and to freedom of navigation and overflight. Malaysia is an important partner for India within the ASEAN grouping, and the two countries are to co-chair an expert working group of ASEAN defence ministers for 2024 to 2027. Malaysia has reiterated its role as a reliable supplier of palm oil to India. Malaysia and India also hold joint military exercises involving the army, navy and air force. Separately, the President of Seychelles visited India and announced a package of assistance. The focus areas of this support are development projects, capacity building and maritime security cooperation. Seychelles is an island country in the Indian Ocean. Both the Malaysia and Seychelles visits stress disaster-resilient infrastructure, and the Seychelles visit also stresses maritime security. Both countries are to work together through the working groups set up during the visit.
